name: Autocomplete
description: Type-ahead input following the HTML autocomplete model: any value is allowed while matching suggestions appear in a keyboard-navigable listbox.
designIntent: Form fields often need both freedom and guidance — usernames, tags, city names. Autocomplete extends the native autocomplete spec: the input stays a normal controlled input (native autoComplete hints keep working), and an ARIA combobox listbox overlays suggestions. Unlike Search, no option constrains the result.

props.name: suggestions
props.description: Suggestion labels offered while typing; any value may still be entered free-form.

props.name: value
props.description: Current text — standard controlled-input contract (wire onValueChange to update it).

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Fires on every keystroke AND on suggestion selection (like a native input's onChange).

props.name: emptyText
props.description: Shown when no suggestion matches (optional; defaults to 'No suggestions').
examples: 'No matches — press Enter to use your text'

examples.title: Controlled form field
examples.description: onValueChange mirrors native onChange; FormField wires the label and hint.

examples.title: Native autofill hints alongside the custom list
examples.description: The native autoComplete attribute passes through — browser autofill and the suggestion list coexist.

antiPatterns.title: Don't use Autocomplete for constrained choice
antiPatterns.explanation: Free text is the point of Autocomplete. When only known values are valid (plan tier, enum), use Select or Search so invalid states cannot be typed.

antiPatterns.title: Don't forget to keep state in sync when controlled
antiPatterns.explanation: With value set, React makes the input fully controlled — if onValueChange does not update the parent state, typing appears frozen.
antiPatterns.example:
<Autocomplete value={v} onValueChange={setV} suggestions={…} /> // wired
<Autocomplete value={v} suggestions={…} /> // frozen — bug

antiPatterns.title: Don't block Enter for form submission
antiPatterns.explanation: Enter only consumes the event when a suggestion is actively highlighted — otherwise it should submit the surrounding form. Avoid adding a global keydown handler that always prevents Enter.
antiPatterns.example: // The component already handles this; no extra wiring needed.

accessibility.implementation: role=combobox with aria-expanded, aria-controls, aria-autocomplete=list, and aria-activedescendant on the input; suggestions render as role=option with aria-selected
accessibility.userRequirements: Provide a name via FormField label or aria-label

accessibility.implementation: ArrowDown/ArrowUp highlight suggestions (wrapping), Home/End jump, Enter accepts the highlighted suggestion, Escape closes the list; unhighlighted Enter submits the form natively
The autoComplete attribute is forwarded to the input so browser autofill hints keep working
accessibility.userRequirements: Set autoComplete='off' only when suggestions must not clash with browser autofill

compositionRules.relationship: Standard form placement — label, hint, and error wiring come free
compositionRules.example: <FormField id="tag" label="Tag" hint="Type to see existing tags"><Autocomplete suggestions={tags} value={tag} onValueChange={setTag} /></FormField>

compositionRules.relationship: Search when values MUST come from the list; Autocomplete when free text stays valid
